evidence_limits: Source-head and base-merge executions are separately bound; repeated names are not additional distinct cases.
The Core failure remains an original ordinary-sharding runtime assertion failure. Earlier isolated success does not replace it. Six-line Dispatch candidate is rejected as incomplete.
Original Foundation selected scopes are not the entire unfiltered workspace; build-only full catalog is not test execution.
Driver process_start provider timeouts do not establish started/not-started/native failure/zero cases. No new key or repeated changed launch is authorized by this evidence.
All future driver-dependent pool pins remain null; no Current, independent Root, FinalUse, external compatibility, scientific adoption or release authority is inferred.
CI run/job counts are non-atomic observations and can expand after metadata jobs. This freeze is not a claim that all CI is terminal.
Scientific B18 HOLD and external B19 acceptance remain under their original exits; prior failures/skips/retries/early returns/cache/unknowns remain preserved.
